parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is optional if you use an AccessKey or STS temporary authorization for authentication.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can get the organization ID from the URL in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. Example: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The ID or full path of the repository.
